cases.name: a-png-a-jpeg-and-a-pdf-fill-a-signature-field
cases.covers: A PNG, a JPEG, a PDF as its bytes and under { pdf } each fill a new signature field: the widget has a mark.

cases.name: other-bytes-and-two-pages-are-refused
cases.covers: Bytes that are no PNG, JPEG or PDF are refused before anything is sent; an image under { pdf } is refused as a PDF; a two-page PDF is refused as bytes and under { pdf }; the field is left without a mark.

cases.name: no-mark-takes-the-mark-out
cases.covers: null takes the mark out of a styled field: the widget has no mark and draws its box again, and its style can change after.

cases.name: undo-of-a-clear-brings-the-mark-back
cases.covers: The undo of a clear brings the mark back; its undo takes it out again.

cases.name: a-mark-and-no-mark-are-ops-of-one-change
cases.covers: A mark and no mark travel as ops of one change, which one undo takes back.

cases.name: no-mark-in-a-field-that-has-none-changes-nothing
cases.covers: null on a field with no mark leaves its widget as it is.

cases.name: a-field-with-two-boxes-is-filled-and-cleared-in-both
cases.covers: Both widgets of one signature field get the mark, and both lose it.

cases.name: a-field-of-another-family-takes-no-mark
cases.covers: A text field takes no mark and gives none up: InvalidArg both ways.
